title: Lost Mary Nera15K Pineapple Peach Mango Prefilled Vape Pods
description: The Pineapple Peach Mango Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod combines three tropical favourites for a smooth and vibrant vape. Sweet Pineapple leads with a juicy tang, mellow Peach softens the blend, and ripe Mango adds richness for a fruity trio that’s bright and satisfying. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together, they deliver up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for messy refills or coil changes. Fitted with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod provides consistent vapour and clear flavour from start to finish. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
